specification.objective: Fix the project/task workspace web rendering defect where previously painted sections can appear ghosted or visually overlaid while scrolling. Keep the glass backdrop effect, but isolate BackdropFilter from the scrollable workspace subtree so scrolling content is painted in a stable compositor layer.

requirements.statement: Workspace sidebar and content SingleChildScrollView widgets must not be descendants of BackdropFilter.
WorkspaceScaffold must retain a single static BackdropFilter layer behind interactive workspace content so the existing glass visual treatment is preserved without filtering the scrolling subtree.
Wide and narrow workspace layout, sidebar, drawer, navigation, and content scrolling behavior must remain functionally unchanged.
The locked POLIS Change Contract for this defect must be versioned at docs/contracts/project-tasks-layout-overlap-fix-v1.polis.json.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A workspace containing scrollable content has no SingleChildScrollView with a BackdropFilter ancestor.
WorkspaceScaffold still renders exactly one BackdropFilter as a static visual background layer.
Existing wide/narrow content builders and workspace navigation remain reachable above the static backdrop layer.
The locked schema-v4 contract is included under docs/contracts/project-tasks-layout-overlap-fix-v1.polis.json in the target tree.

invariants.statement: Project/task domain state, API contracts, authorization, Kanban persistence, and backend behavior are unchanged.
WorkspaceScaffold continues to provide one scrollable sidebar and one scrollable content area in wide layout.
No new Flutter package or renderer-specific dependency is introduced.

forbidden_states.statement: A SingleChildScrollView remains inside the BackdropFilter subtree.
The blur effect is duplicated per card or per scroll item.
Fixing the compositor layering changes project/task business behavior.

inputs.statement: Workspace pages with vertically scrollable content, including the project/task management page on Flutter Web.

outputs.statement: Scrollable workspace content is composed above, rather than inside, the static blur layer.
The visual background retains the existing blur/glass treatment without ghosted workspace sections.

failure_semantics.statement: If the source returns to placing scrollable content under BackdropFilter, the regression command fails closed with workspace_scrollable_inside_backdrop_filter.

argv: from pathlib import Path; import sys; s=Path('lib/features/shared/presentation/widgets/workspace_shell.dart').read_text(); ok=('Widget _buildStaticBackdrop' in s and 'child: ColoredBox(' in s and s.count('BackdropFilter(')==1); print('workspace_backdrop_layering_ok' if ok else 'workspace_scrollable_inside_backdrop_filter'); sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
